subject: Stacking sweeteners: Foundry pilot credits
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@foundrylabs.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits — can we combine with sandbox voucher?

Hi Michael,

Quick question as we prepare the Foundry Labs pilot: we have an accelerator free-credit voucher from our university partner (attached) and a separate sandbox voucher you offered for the pilot. Finance on our side is asking if those can be applied in parallel across two projects (one experimental, one production-bound) rather than forcing us to choose which SKU to apply credits to.

Is Redwood open to allowing concurrent usage (i.e., sandbox voucher for R&D, accelerator credits for staging/preview) or do you require credits to be stacked/converted on a single billing entity?

A few specifics:
- voucher id: FL-ACCEL-2025-77 (see attached PDF)
- pilot start: first week of June, duration: 8 weeks
- expected token run-rate: small now, burst-y later

We'd prefer to avoid an invoice addendum if possible — but we can sign one if required. Also curious about any accounting/tax notes we should be aware of if credits are split between product teams.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Platform
Foundry Labs

Attachments: foundry-voucher.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Liu <emma@foundrylabs.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits — can we combine with sandbox voucher?

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear note and for sending the voucher. Looping in Laura (finance) and Karthik (partner ops) to validate on policy. Two quick questions from my side so we can evaluate a stacking exception:

1) Are the two vouchers issued to the same legal entity / billing email? If not, who will be listed on the invoice?
2) Do you need credits to be usable concurrently for the same model endpoint (different routes) or for distinct projects under the same account?

High-level: we typically disallow "double-dipping" where two promotional instruments offset the same billed tokens. That said, we sometimes permit a constrained pattern where one voucher is limited to non-production usage (sandbox/dev) and the other covers staging/preview/production — effectively routing spend by project tag. If that works for you it reduces accounting complexity.

Laura / Karthik — can we do a one-time credit-routing carveout (sandbox-only scope for voucher FL-ACCEL-2025-77) and record it as an addendum on the HubSpot deal? If finance needs a SOW to approve, share the minimal template and we'll send it to Foundry.

Emma — once I have confirmation on the billing entity and project scoping I'll follow up with the exact addendum language and next steps (DocuSign or in-line acceptance).

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits — can we combine with sandbox voucher?

Thanks for the ping, Michael. Quick finance/ops take below. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Summary: we can approve a narrowly-scoped exception if we (a) create a documented routing rule, (b) ensure vouchers are tied to clear project tags, and (c) issue an addendum to the primary agreement that clarifies tax/accounting treatment. We will not allow both vouchers to offset the same invoice line-item or be applied retroactively.

Proposed approach:
- Scope the accelerator voucher (FL-ACCEL-2025-77) to billing usage tagged with project=prod-preview and project=customer-facing only.
- Scope the Redwood sandbox voucher to usage tagged project=sandbox or environment=dev.
- Create a one-page addendum (SOW-lite) that both parties sign; that will live on the HubSpot deal (FDY-2025-PILOT-183).
- Add a 90-day expiry on the exception — after which standard promo rules apply (no stacking).

Operational notes:
- We need the Foundry billing email and the HubSpot deal owner to create accounting entries and to route the credits correctly.
- Finance needs a copy of the voucher PDF (Emma attached) and a short customer-signed acceptance (DocuSign link is fine).

I'll draft the addendum and post in the deal; Karthik — can you confirm if partner marketplace SKUs or third-party vouchers complicate routing? I suspect only if vouchers belong to different legal entities.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit-exception-sow.docx (template)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Emma Liu <emma@foundrylabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits — can we combine with sandbox voucher?

Quick ops note: marketplace SKUs are fine as long as the account mapping in our billing system references the same customer ID. If Foundry's vouchers are issued to a different legal entity, we'll need a short transfer form.

Emma — can you confirm:
- billing email for the primary account that will receive invoices- will you be ok with the 90-day exception window?
- do you want us to restrict the sandbox voucher to a specific set of endpoints (we can do that via route tags)?

If yes to the above, I'll provision the routing rule and Laura's team will push the addendum into DocuSign. We usually implement routing tags by next-business-day once the addendum is signed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

Emma — quick update and next steps.

Good news: finance approved a one-time stacking exception under the routing model Laura outlined. Summary of the agreement: 
- Accelerator voucher FL-ACCEL-2025-77 will be scoped to project tags: prod-preview, customer-facing.
- Redwood sandbox voucher will be scoped to project tags: sandbox, dev.
- Exception window: 90 days from the date DocuSign is completed.
- No retroactive application or double-offset on the same invoice line.

Next steps for Foundry:
1) Confirm the primary billing email for invoices (reply with the exact address).
2) Sign the SOW-lite addendum: I've started the DocuSign request and Laura's team will route it to you (link: https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?t=fdypilot-addendum).
3) Once signed, Karthik will provision route tags in our billing/runtime and we'll confirm mapping the next business day.

If this works I'll log the change on the HubSpot deal (FDY-2025-PILOT-183) and send a short checklist for your finance team to archive with your voucher.

Happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like to walk through the routing tags.

Thanks and excited to get this pilot running.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
